title: From “it runs” to “it ships”: verifying AI-generated code
titleZh: 从「能跑」到「能上线」：验证 AI 写的代码
summary: Build the release-evidence machine your AI-written project is missing — a ship check that parses what actually ran, refuses zero-test projects, and writes an honest delivery record.
summaryZh: 为你的 AI 项目补上缺失的发布证据机器——一个 ship check：解析实际跑了什么、拒绝零测试项目，并写出诚实的交付记录。
outcome: ship_check.py: one command that turns “the demo worked” into a written delivery record — command, exit code, parsed test count, a verdict that refuses projects with no tests, and an explicit unverified list.
outcomeZh: ship_check.py：一条命令把「演示能跑」变成一份书面交付记录——命令、退出码、解析出的测试数、一个拒绝零测试项目的判定，以及一份显式的未验证清单。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
A small Python project you want to ship more safely
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
一个想交付得更稳的小型 Python 项目
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库

lessons.title: “It runs” is not evidence
lessons.objective: Watch the starter bless a project with no tests and one with a failing test — then want better.
lessons.objectiveZh: 看着 starter 给零测试的项目和有失败测试的项目都盖章放行——然后想要更好的东西。

lessons.title: Define what a release record must prove
lessons.titleZh: 定义发布记录必须证明什么
lessons.objective: Command, exit code, parsed count and outcome, an unverified list, and a verdict that refuses zero-test projects.
lessons.objectiveZh: 命令、退出码、解析出的数量与结果、一份未验证清单，以及一个拒绝零测试项目的判定。

lessons.title: Build the ship check, test by test
lessons.titleZh: 按测试逐组构建 ship check
lessons.objective: Parsing, verdicts, the unverified list, atomic writes, exit codes — one failing group at a time.
lessons.objectiveZh: 解析、判定、未验证清单、原子写入、退出码——一次一组失败测试。

lessons.title: Read the record like a skeptic
lessons.objective: Green, red, and no-tests mean different things — prove you can tell them apart.
lessons.objectiveZh: 绿、红、零测试是三件不同的事——证明你能分辨。

lessons.title: Gate your next release
lessons.titleZh: 给你的下一次发布装上门禁
lessons.objective: Take the ship check to a project you own and make the record part of shipping.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把 ship check 带到你自己的项目，让记录成为交付的一部分。

scenarios.title: Two passing tests
scenarios.blurb: A tiny project with two passing tests and a declared unverified list.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一个带两个通过测试和已声明未验证清单的小项目。

scenarios.title: One wrong expectation
scenarios.blurb: The regression under study: one deliberately wrong test expectation.
scenarios.blurbZh: 正在研究的回归：一个故意写错的测试断言。

scenarios.title: Zero tests
scenarios.blurb: The state that must never pass: no tests at all.
scenarios.blurbZh: 绝不能放行的状态：一个测试都没有。

verification.method: A 10-test suite pins parsed counts, the no-tests verdict, the unverified list, atomic record writes, and CLI exit codes; the starter reproduces seven named failures, the solution passes 10/10.
verification.methodZh: 10 个测试的套件锚定解析计数、零测试判定、未验证清单、原子记录写入及 CLI 退出码；starter 复现七个具名失败，solution 通过 10/10。

levelZh: 拥有 AI 写的 Python 项目
